channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Regulator mulls digital platform for drugmakers' test reports
item.description: To improve transparency, India's drug regulator is developing a digital platform that will allow consumers to view batch-level quality-test reports of medications.&nbsp;

item.title: Trump-Xi Summit: Xi's ‘Thucydides Trap’ warning, push for Taiwan stance — 6 key takeaways from White House talks
item.description: Trump opened the meeting by highlighting his personal relationship with Xi, describing it as a “truly great friendship” built on mutual respect and the interests of both countries.

item.title: White House wants US government review of OpenAI, Anthropic’s new AI models before UK access — Report
item.description: A senior US administration official reportedly said the White House wants to review the models and take steps to ensure US systems are secure before they are shared with American partners.

item.title: Palestine president Mahmoud Abbas at UNGA — What he said on Israeli settlements, US visa ban and elections
item.description: The core message of Abbas' address was that the two-state solution remains the Palestinian leadership's stated objective and that international action is urgently needed to preserve it.

item.title: Republican California Sheriff’s 650,000-ballot seizure declared ‘unlawful’ — What the court said
item.description: The unanimous ruling said voted ballots must remain in the custody and control of election officials, even when law enforcement is investigating suspected election misconduct.

item.title: Netanyahu at UNGA — says attacking Iran was ‘one of the easiest decisions’ he ever made: Key takeaways
item.description: Netanyahu's speech combined a defence of Israel’s wars against Iran and Hamas with attacks on critics including Erdogan and Mamdani, while portraying Israel’s military actions as necessary for its security and that of its allies.

item.title: US-Iran war: Will Strait of Hormuz reopen and blockade end? Both nations discuss phased deal, says report
item.description: US and Iranian negotiators are reportedly discussing a phased arrangement to restore shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, with Iran seeking economic relief and Washington aiming for resumed maritime traffic.

item.title: Dunkin’ Donuts offering 1 million free coffee: Here's how to grab your fav cup of joe today, see promo code
item.description: Dunkin Donuts is offering 1 million free coffees with a promo code on its app. It can be used to buy any hot and cold coffee with some exceptions.

item.title: UPI MDR: ‘Not a single penny’ will go to govt; earnings to be shared among banks and other entities, says report
item.description: The new MDR is scheduled to come into effect from October 15 and will apply only to merchants accepting UPI payments exceeding ₹2,000.

item.title: IIT Bombay suicide: Late student's parents launch hunger strike, mid-sem exam deferred amid caste discrimination claims
item.description: IIT student's suicide: Parents start hunger strike; institute defers mid-semester exams

item.title: Centre to ask banks’ body to ensure consumers don't pay MDR on UPI payments
item.description: The planned outreach by the Indian Banks’ Association aims to put the truth in the public domain and allay any misconceptions about the MDR.

item.title: New York vs Polymarket: Why is the prediction platform facing legal action and what did it say? Explained
item.description: New York Attorney General Letitia James has filed a lawsuit against Polymarket for allegedly violating state gambling laws. This lawsuit follows similar actions against Kalshi and other prediction-market operators for offering unlicensed services and posing risks to users.

item.title: Xi-Trump summit: Nod to historic ‘peace toast’, seabass and a lot of Chinese influence, what's on state dinner menu?
item.description: Xi-Trump state dinner will be held in the East Room of the White House this evening. The black-tie event will see attendance from Amazon's Jeff Bezos, Nvidia's Jensen Huang, and Meta's Mark Zuckerberg among other official delegations, business leaders and government officials.

item.title: California wine industry crisis: Signorello faces foreclosure, Gundlach Bundschu files for bankruptcy
item.description: The developments underscore the pressure facing wine producers that took on significant debt when the wine market was expanding.

item.title: Who is Suneel Lodhi? Soulful voice of 'Maine Tere Hi Bharose Hanuman' song from Neem Karoli Baba movie Hanuman Ansh
item.description: Suneel Lodhi, in an interview with Doordarshan, had shared that he never received formal training or had a music coach.

item.title: FDA upgrades Vitruvias Therapeutics recall: Superpotent thyroid tablets could trigger heart problems; who is at risk?
item.description: The FDA has classified Vitruvias Therapeutics' recall of thyroid tablets as Class I due to potential superpotency, posing a risk of serious health issues. The affected lot includes approximately 3,655 units.&nbsp;

item.title: Govern AI before scaling it: RBI’s 10 commandments for tech risk
item.description: RBI deputy governor Rohit Jain calls for stronger governance, greater visibility into technology infrastructure, tighter controls and regular testing of operational resilience as financial institutions increasingly adopt AI.

item.title: Draft National Electricity Policy set for inter-ministerial consultation
item.description: The new policy emphasizes on grid flexibility amid growing renewable energy integration and potential demand from data centres and green hydrogen plants

item.title: Harsh Goenka compares China, India business focus, cites JL MAG: ‘What are we building that world will need tomorrow?’
item.description: RPG Enterprises Chairman Harsh Goenka compares India and China's business focus, highlighting China's dominance in future industries like rare earths and robotics. He urges India to shift from consumer goods to crucial sectors that will shape the global economy in the next two decades.

item.title: ₹6,000 crore Mahadev Betting App case: CBI arrests ‘kingpin’ Abhishek Kumar at Hyderabad airport after Dubai return
item.description: The investigation conducted so far revealed the active role of Abhishek Kumar in running online betting and gambling operations under Mahadev Book in collection of funds and in acquiring immovable assets in Dubai out of the ill-gotten proceeds of betting and gambling, CBI said.

item.title: Who is Nisarga Adhikary? 19-year-old Indian honoured by US DoJ for finding ‘critical vulnerability’ in law enforcement
item.description: The teenager’s cybersecurity work has also extended to US military systems, where he said he has identified and reported vulnerabilities to the authorities.

item.title: Xi Jinping at White House: Full Trump-Xi schedule, gift exchange, and state dinner - What's planned?
item.description: Xi will be accompanied by his wife, Peng Liyuan, with the White House preparing a formal welcome featuring a military ceremony, gift exchange, bilateral meetings and a state dinner.

item.title: Trump-Xi talks at White House today: 4 key issues on agenda as US-China leaders hold historic talks
item.description: Artificial intelligence is emerging as a major area of strategic competition between the US and China. Trump has repeatedly argued that the US is ahead of China in the race for AI leadership.

item.title: From slamming Obama's Xi welcome to rolling out the red carpet: Trump’s dramatic China shift in 14 years
item.description: Trump once questioned Obama’s reception of Xi Jinping. Fourteen years later, he personally welcomed the Chinese president to Washington with an elaborate military ceremony.

item.title: Is tuna safe to eat? ICAR-CMFRI issues clarification after parasite reports in skipjack tuna from Brazil
item.description: ICAR-CMFRI advises against avoiding tuna over parasite reports from other regions

item.title: US weekly jobless claims fall to 197,000, near historic lows as layoffs stay low
item.description: New claims for unemployment benefits in the U.S. fell to 197,000 last week, indicating a strengthening labor market.&nbsp;

item.title: As Trump meets Xi, Politico, MS NOW, CNN personnel denied entry into White House despite court overturning ban
item.description: A federal judge ordered the Trump administration to temporarily lift a ban on CNN, MS NOW and Politico journalists. However, they were still denied entry into the White House, as per the latest update.

item.title: Netanyahu UN speech: 5 things to watch as Israel PM addresses Gaza, Iran and Mamdani
item.description: The speech comes at a politically sensitive moment for Netanyahu, with Israel's general election scheduled for October 27 and his government facing criticism over the Gaza war and Israel's international standing.

item.title: AI to dominate Trump-Xi Jinping talks? US President cites DOJ ‘guardrail’, says ‘want to leave it exactly where it is’
item.description: President Donald Trump stated that artificial intelligence will be a key topic during his meeting with Xi Jinping, emphasising that both countries prefer to maintain their current stance on the technology. Trump noted existing US safeguards to oversee AI companies amidst industry concerns.

item.title: 'Tukaram Mundhe sir, where are you?': Woman finds dead fly in ₹500 Starbucks drink; company responds
item.description: Disheartened by the incident, Shikha addressed Tukaram Mundhe, who is leading a strict crackdown on food safety violations in Maharashtra, and sought action against the coffee chain.

item.title: Nor’easter forecast day by day: What to expect across US East Coast through Monday
item.description: New York City and, in particular, Boston are expected to remain weather-sensitive areas as the storm moves north and intensifies.

item.title: Samsung AI smart fridge start shutting down by themselves, company notes ‘abnormal symptoms’ after system update: Report
item.description: From September 22, several customers alleged that Samsung smart fridges turned themselves off unexpectedly after a system update. The update was said to be for “code stabilisation”.

item.title: Denmark’s new work visa could open jobs for Indians: Who qualifies and what’s the ₹47 lakh salary threshold?
item.description: Denmark will introduce a work permit route for Indian nationals starting 1 January 2027, allowing certified Danish employers to hire from 16 countries, including India.&nbsp;

item.title: Adani Arogya Mandir: Gautam Adani announces ₹4,000 cr Bengal project; 2,000-bed facility likely to create 10,000+ jobs
item.description: Gautam Adani announced over ₹4,000 crore investment for the Adani Arogya Mandir in West Bengal, promising over 10,000 jobs. The 2,000-bed healthcare facility aims to support economically weaker patients and will reportedly include a medical college and advanced research amenities.

item.title: Saudi Arabia alerts Mecca over potential missile, drone threat; 2nd warning this month
item.description: Jeddah, Yanbu, and Tabuk were among the other areas of Saudi Arabia where the warning was issued.
